items.name: The Rashtrakuta kingdom
items.formula: Kannadigas, once tributaries of the Chalukyas; their kingdom ran from the Narmada to the Cauvery.

items.name: Amoghavarsha
items.formula: A peace-loving king who made marriage ties with the Gangas and Pallavas.
items.example: The Arab traveller Sulaiman called him one of the four great emperors of the world.

items.name: Rashtrakuta administration
items.formula: Rashtra (mandala), vishaya, nadu and grama, with the vishayapati, rashtrapati and nadagavunda.
items.example: Income: land revenue, tolls and taxes on trades like ferries.

items.name: Rashtrakuta literature
items.formula: Shrivijaya's Kavirajamarga, the first Kannada work; Pampa's Adipurana and Vikramarjunavijaya; Ponna's Shanti Purana.

items.name: Vaddaradhane
items.formula: A prose collection of Jain stories by Shivakotiacharya.
items.example: It uses native Kannada words and comes before Pampa.

items.name: Nadoja award
items.formula: Given each year by Kannada University, Hampi, in memory of Pampa.
items.example: Salotgi in Vijayapura district was a leading centre of learning.

items.name: Kailashnath temple at Ellora
items.formula: A monolith built by Krishna I, from a rock 100 feet high, 276 feet long and 154 feet wide.
items.example: The Elephanta caves near Mumbai have the Ardhanarishwara and Maheshamurti.

items.name: Tailapa II
items.formula: A Rashtrakuta tributary who beat Karka II, took Manyakheta and founded the Kalyana Chalukya kingdom.

items.name: Someshwara I
items.formula: Built Kalyana (today's Basava Kalyana in Bidar) as his capital.
items.example: He beat Rajadhiraja Chola at Koppam.

items.name: Vikramaditya VI
items.formula: The greatest Kalyana Chalukya; began the Chalukya Vikrama era in 1076 C.E.
items.example: Vignaneshwara, author of Mitakshara, lived in his time.

items.name: Basaveshwara
items.formula: Taught "Kayave Kailasa" (the body is Shiva's abode) and wrote vachanas in everyday Kannada.
items.example: He set up the Anubhava Mantapa in 1162 C.E.; Karnataka named him its Cultural Leader in 2024.

items.name: Kalyana Chalukya literature
items.formula: Ranna: Gadayuddha. Durgasimha: Panchatantra. Bilhana: Vikramankadeva Charita. Nayasena: Dharmamruta.
items.example: Someshwara III's Manasollasa is a Sanskrit encyclopaedia.

items.name: Kalyana Chalukya temples and mints
items.formula: Kashi Vishweshwara at Lakkundi, Mahadev at Itagi, Trikuteshwara at Gadag.
items.example: Mints at Lakkundi and Sudi made gadyana, pana and other coins.

mistakes.text: Kavirajamarga (Shrivijaya) is the first Kannada work; Pampa is called Adikavi, the first poet.
The Kailasanath at Ellora is Rashtrakuta; the Kailasanath at Kanchi is Pallava.
Karka II was the last Rashtrakuta; Tailapa II, who beat him, began the Kalyana Chalukyas.
